scoring_justification: Recompute from raw simulation outputs (E(V) points, band eigenvalues) is infeasible because the submitted artifacts are only the final extracted structural parameters and band gaps; no raw simulation data is scored. The checker compares the reported values to the paper's values with tolerances and checks qualitative trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for structural properties (step_02) and band gaps (step_04), taken from Table 2 and Table 4 of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Electronic and structural properties of strontium chalcogenides SrS, SrSe and SrTe' (phys. stat. sol. (b) 241, No. 11, 2529–2537 (2004)), Table 2 (structural properties) and Table 4 (band gaps).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription of the 'calc. (present paper)' columns from the paper tables.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results, serving as the authoritative reproduction target.

outputs.description: Structural parameters for SrS, SrSe, SrTe in B1 and B2 structures, extracted from DFT equation-of-state fitting.
Indirect band gap (Γ–X) in eV for SrS, SrSe, SrTe in the B1 (NaCl) structure, obtained from DFT band structure calculations.

output_contract.notes: No gold values or tolerances are public. The verifier uses hidden reference values and verifies qualitative trends.
